Policy Reference: Section 4.2 Courier Damage

Clause 4.2.1 (Carrier Transit Indemnification): When outer packaging puncture or conveyor compression damage is documented upon initial delivery scan, the platform shall immediately refund the customer without penalty and initiate an automated carrier liability recovery claim.

Clause 4.2.2 (Merchant Exoneration): Merchants providing verified dispatch CCTV footage demonstrating intact packaging and matching SKU barcodes shall be exonerated from product defect penalties.
